steps.content: The Mania on the beach is suppressed by the shackles you released. The once madly expanding man-eating swamp has begun to recede, revealing the original beach and coral reefs.

This is obviously a good thing, but the girl you woke up and saved has no time to be grateful. She's squatting on the beach and futilely scooping up sand, in the middle of a breakdown. She purses her lips tightly, as if about to cry.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: How did this happen... How!

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: How could my swamp be fake... This is different from what the island owner told me!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fake or not, this is no place for a child to spend days in.
She bows her head and her shoulders are convulsing, as if she's still overwhelmed by the shattering of her dream. You feel sorry and try to comfort her.
You instinctively reach into your pocket, but soon remember this is not the real world. You won't find that candy you put in your pocket before coming.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Hmph, save it. I've always known this day would come.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Someone like me can't escape the so-called punishment. I'll tell you whatever you want to know...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: As long as... you say nothing to my family.
The little girl still appears prickly. You sigh and notice not far from her, a black smartphone lies there alone on the beach, its screen flashing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Elysiland... Forum... General chat section?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And foodie section, gaming section, cosmetic surgery section...!

You pick up her phone, and glimpse at the constantly refreshing posts in all these sections on the screen. They remind you of many guests you've seen since arriving on Elysiland, not to mention that the island and the manta ray on the logo also look strikingly familiar.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course... Elysiland and this Elysiland Forum on the dark web are mirror images of each other. A desire on the forum corresponds to a fulfillment on the island.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All of this is probably controlled by L.L., the island owner? But just how does she do it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Her Sinner ability should be S-Class, but even so, can she really sustain a whole island...?
You look at the constantly refreshing forum on the phone, then at the people indulging in ecstasy in every corner of this island. You feel that there must be a connection between them.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Of course, she can!
You hear the sob-tinged voice again. You look up and find Shrooma staring at you, as if ready to take you down.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know about it? Can you tell me?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: According to L.L., her power seems to come from the bottom of the sea or some place like that. She's like a fish and needs to live in water. That's why she keeps taking us to the seabed.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Those people from under the sea... Or is it under... ground? They said that as long as Elysiland created by L.L. can gather enough emotional energy, then L.L. herself can enjoy many experiences she has never had before.
Shrooma wants to go on, but seems to suddenly remember you haven't yet agreed to her terms. She bites her lip and falls silent.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, yes, I promise you. I won't make things difficult for you, nor will I tell your family about this. You're still young. Once you leave, I'll help you erase the data left on the island.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: ...Alright. As long as you keep your word. Don't forget, lying is wrong, even for adults!
After giving you a proper warning, Shrooma continues her explanation.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: That forum... Elysiland. At first, it was just a gathering place for people with niche hobbies, as in, hobbies not tolerated by the mainstream.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Filth is only safe in a pit of filth... But there's no place in this world for filth. So we can only hide.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Only when the world is completely covered in swamps and filth, people like us can finally live without shame.
The girl fiddles with the cute watch on her wrist nervously. The accessory is much more appropriate for her age, creating a sharp contrast with her phone.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: This is my wish. This is how I can exist happily.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: I came here because the island owner said that Elysiland could offer me this kind of life.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But what benefit does it bring her? And what do you mean by "her source of power"?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Joy and satisfaction are the benefits. Although she is the island owner, she is also one of us. She has said many times that she likes having fun with us.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: She likes to see everyone have their desires fulfilled, to see everyone indulge in pleasure, as if that would also bring her joy...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: She also said... everyone would always stay with her, because... once people find out how easy it is to satisfy a desire on Elysiland, no one can resist the temptation to stay.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The more content and satisfied you guys are, the more energy this island gains, and the stronger I become! That way, the world you desire will grow even larger too!
The girl glances at you, both grateful and wary.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: That's why I don't want to leave! A poisonous mushroom is only safe when buried in the mud... But there's no place for filthy mud or poisonous mushrooms in this world.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: My joy will transform into energy for her, maintaining my swamp and strengthening her power...

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: Now you've woken people like us up, cutting off the joy and the energy. That's why my swamp is gone.

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: I just hope to live happily in this world.
Although her account is filled with subjective speculation, her logic is clear and supposedly accurate. It also provides you with enough information.
You can't help but wonder, is this accuracy a result of her deep understanding of L.L. and the forum, or her analytical ability far superior to people her age?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: ...Was that useful? Can I leave now?

steps.speaker: Shrooma
steps.content: I, I've still got homework to finish. No one told me I'd be kept here for so long...
Your silence makes the girl anxious. Afraid you will break your promise, she starts mumbling things she thinks may move an adult.
After some thought, you keep your promise, hand her back the smartphone, and send a message to the MBCC staff, asking them to have the network specialist release the data of Shrooma's consciousness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You may go. Don't worry, I'm not an adult who lies to kids. If you really can't find an excuse, maybe I can help you make one up.
Hearing your words, she stumbles a little while dashing toward the pier. You can't help but shake your head with a laugh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Kids sure are fickle. Suddenly, all she can think of is the possibility of getting caught and the urge to rush back home.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If only the owner of this place... also had such deep ties to the real world.
